config.title: Flutter Tools for HarmonyOS
config.flutterOhos.flutterPath.descripti: Flutter executable. Point this to the Flutter OHOS fork's `flutter`/`flutter.bat` if it is not on PATH.
config.flutterOhos.dartPath.description: Dart executable used by `dart format` and `dart run build_runner`.
config.flutterOhos.android.sdkPath.descr: Android SDK path. Falls back to ANDROID_HOME / ANDROID_SDK_ROOT / common locations.
Android `emulator` binary path. Falls back to <androidSdk>/emulator/emulator.
config.flutterOhos.ios.simulatorDevice.d: Preferred iOS Simulator UDID or name. Leave empty to pick from a list.
config.flutterOhos.ios.simulatorApp.desc: Path to the simulator UI app. Auto-detected (Simulator.app / DeviceHub.app); override if your Xcode places it elsewhere.
config.flutterOhos.harmony.sdkPath.descr: HarmonyOS / OpenHarmony SDK path (DevEco Studio SDK). Falls back to DEVECO_SDK_HOME, OHOS_SDK_HOME, /Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk.
config.flutterOhos.harmony.hdcPath.descr: Path to the `hdc` tool. Falls back to <harmonySdk>/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc.
Path to the HarmonyOS emulator binary (DevEco `Emulator`/`Emulator.exe`). Falls back to OHOS_EMULATOR_HOME and the DevEco Studio install.
config.flutterOhos.harmony.devecoPath.de: Path to DevEco Studio.app, used by the 'Open DevEco Studio' command.
config.flutterOhos.terminal.name.descrip: Name of the integrated terminal used to run Flutter commands.
config.flutterOhos.terminal.reuse.descri: Reuse a single terminal for Flutter commands instead of creating a new one.
config.flutterOhos.run.mainEntry.descrip: Dart entrypoint passed to debug sessions. Defaults to lib/main.dart when present.
config.flutterOhos.run.extraArgs.descrip: Extra arguments appended to every `flutter run` / debug session, e.g. `--dart-define=ENV=dev`.
config.flutterOhos.run.pubGetBeforeRun.d: Run `flutter pub get` before every run/debug launch.
config.flutterOhos.refreshOnStartup.desc: Automatically refresh the device list when the extension activates.
config.flutterOhos.locale.description: Language used by the extension's own UI (sidebar, status bar, dialogs). 'auto' follows the VS Code display language. Command palette titles and settings names always follow the VS Code display language.
config.flutterOhos.locale.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
